name: Spherical Harmonics Regularization
definition: A training strategy that restricts the maximum degree of Spherical Harmonics during early optimization to prevent high-frequency overfitting and improve coarse geometry reconstruction.
summary: Spherical Harmonics Regularization restricts high-frequency SH coefficients during early training to prevent overfitting, distinguishing itself by applying frequency regularization directly to voxel grid coefficients rather than positional encodings.
